label: prop:three-halves-structural-factor
title: Lepton-tower closure structural identities — muon (3+h²)/(2+h²) = [3]_q·[2]_q/[4]_q and tau [6]_q = [2]_q·[3]_q·(1+h²) — proved over generic [CommRing R] with q : Units R, division-free.
html:
Let R be a commutative ring, q \in R^{\times} a unit, h = q - q^{-1}, and [n]_q = q^{n-1} + q^{n-3} + \cdots + q^{-(n-1)} the symmetric q-integer. The following five algebraic identities hold:

Muon set (canonical for T(2,5), used by conj:lepton-tower-h-n-plus-1-branching at m = 2):

3 + h^2 = [3]_q
(2 + h^2) \cdot [2]_q = [4]_q
(3 + h^2) \cdot [4]_q = [3]_q \cdot [2]_q \cdot (2 + h^2)

Tau set (canonical for amphichiral 10_{43} candidate, used by conj:lepton-tower-h-n-plus-1-branching at m = 3):

[6]_q = [2]_q \cdot [3]_q \cdot (1 + h^2)
[5]_q \cdot [3]_q \cdot [2]_q \cdot (1 + h^2) = [5]_q \cdot [6]_q

Whenever R is in addition a field and the relevant denominators are nonzero, the last identity of each set is the cross-multiplied form of the quotient presentations \frac{3 + h^2}{2 + h^2} = \frac{[3]_q \cdot [2]_q}{[4]_q} and \frac{[5]_q \cdot [3]_q}{[6]_q} = \frac{[5]_q}{[2]_q \cdot (1 + h^2)}.

Lean

All five identities are proved in three-halves-structural-factor.lean over a generic commutative ring [CommRing R] with the modulus carried as a unit q : Units R, each by a single linear_combination against ↑q * ↑q⁻¹ = 1 — no field_simp, no division, no ordering. A field is used only in the RatioForm section, where the two quotient presentations are recovered from the cross-multiplied identities by div_eq_div_iff. Generic-ring proofs apply at the substrate q_0 \approx 1.110 by specialisation; numerical cross-checks at 50-dps mpmath verify each identity to \leq 10^{-40} in the tau-amphichiral-sdp-probe.witness.json witness (assertions lean_three_plus_h_sq_eq_bracket3, lean_two_plus_h_sq_times_bracket2_eq_bracket4, lean_bracket6_eq_bracket2_bracket3_times_one_plus_h_sq).

Role in the framework

The structural identities reveal that the canonical lepton-tower closure factors \xi_m live in a single h-graded family of q-bracket products. Concretely:

  • Muon (m = 2, K_\mu = 4_1): closure factor \xi_2 = [3]_q \cdot [2]_q / [4]_q = (3+h^2)/(2+h^2) — closes m_\mu/m_e via \mathrm{Vol}(4_1)/\hbar_q^2 to 0.034 % of CODATA.
  • Tau (m = 3, K_\tau = 10_{43} candidate): closure factor \xi_3 = [5]_q \cdot [3]_q / [6]_q — closes m_\tau/m_e via \mathrm{Vol}(10_{43})/\hbar_q^2 to +0.79 % of CODATA. The reduction [6]_q = [2]_q \cdot [3]_q \cdot (1 + h^2) is the fundamental identity behind this closure.

The generic family is the subject of conj:lepton-tower-h-n-plus-1-branching; this proposition supplies the proved algebraic core for the muon (m=2) and tau (m=3) cases.
